-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.Protocol.GhostState` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem rqLb_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (L T : w64) (recs : List RqRec) : Persistent (rqLb γ L T
    recs)

def ownRaftGhost [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (md : Bool :=
    false) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γv voted kl,
      "%Hname" ∷ ⌜γ.reVotes !! id = some γv⌝ ∗
        "%Hidnz" ∷ ⌜id ≠ W64 0⌝ ∗
          "Hvoted" ∷ ghostMapAuth γv (Qp.half 1) voted ∗
            "%Hhist" ∷ ⌜VoteHistOk voted s⌝ ∗
              ("#Hfrags" ∷ [∗map] t ↦ c ∈ voted, isVote γ id t c) ∗
                ("#Hout" ∷ [∗list] m ∈ s.outbox, isMessage γ m) ∗
                  ("#Htally" ∷ [∗map] v ↦ _u ∈ toMap (granted s.votes), isVote γ v s.term id) ∗
                    "#Hlead" ∷ leaderWit γ id s ∗
                      "Hlg" ∷ ownLogGhost γ id s kl ∗
                        "%Hlead_ok" ∷ ⌜LeadOk id s⌝ ∗
                          "%Hfollower_votes" ∷ ⌜FollowerVotesOk s⌝ ∗
                            ("#Hvrecs" ∷ [∗map] t ↦ c ∈ voted, voteJust γ id t c) ∗
                              "%Hrole_ok" ∷ ⌜RoleOk id s⌝ ∗
                                "Hlcm" ∷ lcmOwn γ id s ∗ "Hrd" ∷ rdOwn γ id s ∗ "%Hmode" ∷ ⌜γ.reDyn.isSome = md⌝)

def propAu1 [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (Q : List EntryM → IProp GF) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(AU <{ ∃∃ L, rLog γ L }> @ ⊤ \ ↑(raftN γ), ∅ <{ ∀∀ e,
        rLog γ (L ++ [e]) ∗
          entDataIs γ e (some d) ∗
            ⌜uint.Z e.Index' = ↑L.length + 1 ∧ uint.Z e.Index' < ↑(receiptBound GF) + ↑γ.reBoot.length⌝,
        COMM □ Q L }>)

theorem readAu_persistent [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (Qr : List EntryM → IProp GF) : Persistent
    (readAu γ Qr)

theorem dynEnv_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (c : CfgM) (s : PState) :
    Persistent (dynEnv γ id c s)

theorem pbecomeFollower_vote_ne (s : PState) (term lead : w64) : term ≠ s.term → (pbecomeFollower s
    term lead).vote = W64 0

theorem rdCount_append (a b : List Msg) : rdCount (a ++ b) = rdCount a + rdCount b

def ownLogGhost [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl : Option w64)
    : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γm terms γa acks fp γc camps γl vlogs γw wins,
      "%Htname" ∷ ⌜γ.reTerms !! id = some γm⌝ ∗
        "Hterms" ∷ ghostMapAuth γm 1 terms ∗
          ("#Htfrags" ∷ [∗map] t ↦ γt ∈ terms, t ↪[γm]□ γt) ∗
            "%Hterms_ok" ∷ ⌜TermsOk terms s⌝ ∗
              "Htlog" ∷ leadLogOwn γ s terms ∗
                "%Haname" ∷ ⌜γ.reAcks !! id = some γa⌝ ∗
                  "Hacks" ∷ ghostMapAuth γa 1 acks ∗
                    ("#Hafrags" ∷ [∗map] k ↦ u ∈ acks, k ↪[γa]□ u) ∗
                      "%Hacks_term" ∷ ⌜AcksTerm s acks⌝ ∗
                        "#Hacks_ok" ∷ acksOk γ s acks ∗
                          "%Hlog_ok" ∷ ⌜LogOk s⌝ ∗
                            "#Hrecs" ∷ logRecs γ s.base s.log ∗
                              "#Hmatched" ∷ matchedOk γ s ∗
                                "#Hcommit" ∷ commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term ∗
                                  "#Hbase" ∷ baseOk γ s.base ∗
                                    "%Hfull" ∷ ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ PlogWf s.base s.log ∧ TermsLe s (fp ++ s.log)⌝ ∗
                                      "#Hfrecs" ∷ logRecs γ base0 fp ∗
                                        "%Hcname" ∷ ⌜γ.reCamp !! id = some γc⌝ ∗
                                          "Hcamps" ∷ ghostMapAuth γc 1 camps ∗
                                            "%Hcamps_ok" ∷
                                                ⌜∀ (T : w64), (camps !! T).isSome = true → uint.Z T ≤ uint.Z s.term⌝ ∗
                                              "#Hcown" ∷ campOwn γ id s (fp ++ s.log) ∗
                                                "%Hlname" ∷ ⌜γ.reVlogs !! id = some γl⌝ ∗
                                                  "Hvlogs" ∷ ghostMapAuth γl 1 vlogs ∗
                                                    "#Hvlogs_ok" ∷ vlogsOk γ s acks vlogs ∗
                                                      "#Hhists" ∷ histsOk γ s kl (fp ++ s.log) acks ∗
                                                        "%Hwname" ∷ ⌜γ.reWins !! id = some γw⌝ ∗
                                                          "Hwins" ∷ ghostMapAuth γw 1 wins ∗
                                                            "%Hwins_ok" ∷ ⌜WinsOk wins s⌝ ∗
                                                              "#Hkl" ∷ klOk γ id s kl ∗
                                                                "Hevs" ∷ ownEvs γ id s.term acks ∗
                                                                  "#Hinv" ∷ raftCommitInv γ ∗
                                                                    "#Hcmt" ∷ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp s) ∗
                                                                      "%Hlacks" ∷ ⌜LeadAcksOk s acks⌝ ∗
                                                                        "%Hboot" ∷ ⌜↑γ.reBoot.length ≤ uint.Z s.commit⌝)

def readAu [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (Qr : List EntryM → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ AU <{ ∃∃ L, rLog γ L }> @ ⊤ \ ↑(raftN γ), ∅ <{ rLog γ L, COMM □ Qr L }>)

def leadLogOwn (_γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (terms : GMap w64 TermRec) : IProp GF :=
  match s.role with
  | Role.leader =>
    iprop(∃ γt M l0,
        ⌜terms !! s.term = some ((γt, s.base), l0)⌝ ∗
          ghostMapAuth γt 1 M ∗
            ([∗map] i ↦ e ∈ M, i ↪[γt]□ e) ∗
              ⌜∀ (i : w64), (M !! i).isSome = true → uint.Z i ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log⌝ ∗
                ⌜l0 <+: s.log⌝ ∗ leadFrags γt l0 s.log)
  | x => iprop(True)

theorem raftN_open_sub {γ : RaftNames} : ⊤ \ ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ (⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)) \ ↑(raftLogN γ)

theorem votesTbl_just [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v T c : w64) : ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ isVote γ v T c
    -∗ voteJust γ v T c

theorem rLog_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (L : List EntryM) : Timeless (rLog γ L)

theorem rdOwn_rdFacts [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (Hr : s.role
    = Role.leader) : ⊢ rdOwn γ id s -∗ ⌜(∀ (v a : w64), s.rd.ro.acks !! v = some a → uint.nat a ≤
    uint.nat s.rd.ro.confirmed + s.rd.ro.pending.length) ∧ (∀ (q : ReadReq), q ∈ s.rd.ro.pending →
    q.ents ≠ []) ∧ ∀ (p : MessageM × List EntryM), p ∈ s.rd.pend → p.snd ≠ []⌝

def rdOwn [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γl rqm,
      ⌜γ.reRdq !! id = some γl⌝ ∗
        ghostMapAuth γl 1 rqm ∗
          ([∗map] t ↦ γq ∈ rqm, t ↪[γl]□ γq) ∗
            ⌜LcmOk rqm s⌝ ∗
              rdLead γ s rqm ∗
                ([∗list] st ∈ s.rd.states, readStateRaw γ st) ∗
                  ([∗list] p ∈ s.rd.pend, iprop(∃ e c Lc, ⌜p.snd = [e]⌝ ∗ ⌜e.Data' = c⌝ ∗ readReq γ c Lc)) ∗
                    rdCred γ (s.rd.pend.length + rdCount s.outbox) ∗ rdCredInv γ ∗ msgsTks γ s.outbox)

theorem dynEnv_static [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (c : CfgM) (s : PState) (HC :
    CfgStatic γ c) : ⊢ dynEnv γ id c s

theorem isMessage_appResp_rej_inv [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.appResp
    → m.reject = true → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ ⌜γ.reBoot ≠ [] → ↑γ.reBoot.length < uint.Z m.index ∧ 1 ≤
    uint.Z m.rejecthint ∧ uint.Z m.rejecthint ≤ uint.Z m.index⌝

def raftCommitInv [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(raftLogInv γ ∗ raftRegInv γ)

def propFresh (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) : IProp GF :=
  d ↪[γ.reFresh] ()

def raftLogInv [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv (raftLogN γ) (raftLogInvBody γ)

def readStateRaw (γ : RaftNames) (st : ReadStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c, ⌜st.RequestCtx' = c⌝ ∗ readOk γ c st.Index')

def LogOk (s : PState) : Prop :=
  PlogWfR s.base s.log ∧ uint.Z s.base.index' ≤ uint.Z s.commit ∧ uint.Z s.commit ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log

theorem ownEvs_vote [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id T T' : w64) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) (d
    : Bool) (F : List EntryM) : uint.Z T ≤ uint.Z T' → ⊢ ownEvs γ id T acks -∗ ([∗map] k ↦ _u ∈
    acks, iprop(∀ x, hist γ F k.fst k.snd (vbnd T' d))) ==∗ ownEvs γ id T' acks ∗ voteEv γ id T' d F

def rdCred (γ : RaftNames) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  own γ.reRdCred (◯ n)

theorem rdOwn_mono [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) : (s'.role =
    Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term ∧ s'.rd = s.rd) → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader →
    s'.rd.ro = { pending := [], acks := ∅, confirmed := W64 0 } ∨ s.role ≠ Role.leader ∧ s'.rd.ro =
    s.rd.ro) → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader → uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term) →
    uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term → s'.rd.states = s.rd.states → s'.rd.pend = s.rd.pend → rdCount
    s'.outbox ≤ rdCount s.outbox → (propsOf s'.outbox).Subperm (propsOf s.outbox) → (s'.role =
    Role.candidate → s.role = Role.candidate ∨ uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term) → rdOwn γ id s ⊢
    rdOwn γ id s'

theorem entsData_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : Timeless (entsData γ l)

theorem raftRegN_sub {γ : RaftNames} : ↑(raftRegN γ) ⊆ ⊤ \ ↑(raftLogN γ)

def regsAt [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ R RR, propsOwn γ l R ∗ readsReg γ l RR ∗ noopAu γ)

def HbAckOk (v : w64) (q : Nat) (recs : List RqRec) : Prop :=
  q ≤ recs.length ∧ ∀ (r : RqRec), r ∈ List.take q recs → ∀ (t' : w64) (qq : GSet w64), r.snd = some (t', qq) → ¬v ∈ qq

def vbnd (T : w64) (d : Bool) : Int :=
  uint.Z T + if d = true then 1 else 0

def leaderWit (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) : IProp GF :=
  match s.role with
  | Role.leader => isLeader γ id s.term
  | x => iprop(True)

theorem logRest_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : Timeless (logRest γ l)

theorem pbecomeFollower_vote_same (s : PState) (lead : w64) : (pbecomeFollower s s.term lead).vote =
    s.vote

theorem ev_pair [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v t i T : w64) (d : Bool) (F : List EntryM) : uint.Z
    t < uint.Z T → ⊢ ackEv γ v t i -∗ voteEv γ v T d F -∗ hist γ F t i (vbnd T d)

theorem noopAu_fire [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) (e : EntryM) (Hidx :
    uint.Z e.Index' = ↑l.length + 1) (Hrb : uint.Z e.Index' < ↑(receiptBound GF) + ↑γ.reBoot.length)
    : ⊢ noopAu γ -∗ entDataIs γ e none -∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) l ={⊤ \ ↑(raftN γ)}=∗
    ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) (l ++ [e])

theorem isMessage_grant [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (src dst term : w64) : isVote γ src term dst
    ⊢ isMessage γ (Msg.plain MsgType.voteResp src dst term false)

def TermRec : Type :=
  (GName × entryID) × List EntryM

def readOk (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (i : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Lc, readReq γ c Lc ∗ ⌜↑Lc.length ≤ uint.Z i⌝)

def committedJust [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜l = γ.reBoot ∧ PlogWf base0 γ.reBoot⌝ ∨
      ∃ t n G ldr, cq γ t n G ∗ ⌜l = List.take (uint.Z n).toNat G⌝ ∗ isLeader γ ldr t ∗ cmtLb γ ldr t n)

def respFacts (γ : RaftNames) (q : ReadReq) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ e c, ⌜q.ents = [e]⌝ ∗ ⌜e.Data' = c⌝ ∗ readOk γ c q.index)

def histsOk [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (kl : Option w64) (F : List EntryM) (acks :
    GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) : IProp GF :=
  [∗map] k ↦ _u ∈ acks, hist γ F k.fst k.snd (bnd s kl)

theorem raftCommitInv_reg [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : raftCommitInv γ ⊢ raftRegInv γ

theorem vote_hist_fresh (voted : GMap w64 w64) (s : PState) (t : w64) : VoteHistOk voted s → uint.Z
    s.term < uint.Z t → voted !! t = none

theorem ackOk_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (k : w64 × w64) : Persistent
    (ackOk γ s k)

def raftLogN (γ : RaftNames) : Namespace :=
  raftN γ.@"log"

theorem rdCredInv_persistent [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : Persistent (rdCredInv γ)

theorem HbAckOk_zero (v : w64) (recs : List RqRec) : HbAckOk v 0 recs

theorem klOk_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl : Option w64) : Persistent (klOk
    γ id s kl)

theorem rdOwn_regLb [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (Hr : s.role =
    Role.leader) : ⊢ rdOwn γ id s -∗ ∃ recs, ⌜recs.length = uint.nat s.rd.ro.confirmed +
    s.rd.ro.pending.length⌝ ∗ rqLb γ id s.term recs ∗ [∗list] r ∈ recs, rqRecOk γ s.term r

theorem lcmLead_leader [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (s : PState) (lcm : GMap w64 GName) (h : s.role =
    Role.leader) : lcmLead s lcm = iprop(∃ γc c, ⌜lcm !! s.term = some γc⌝ ∗ monoNatAuthOwn γc 1 c ∗
    ⌜c ≤ uint.nat s.commit⌝)

def cprefix (fp : List EntryM) (s : PState) : List EntryM :=
  List.take (uint.Z s.commit).toNat (fp ++ s.log)

theorem propIs_deposited [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (Q : List EntryM → IProp GF) :
    ⊢ propIs γ d Q -∗ deposited γ d

def msgCert [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜m.ty ≠ MsgType.snap⌝ ∨ raftSnapCert γ (msgSnapTrip m))

theorem ownRaftGhost_static [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) : ⊢
    ownRaftGhost γ id s -∗ ⌜γ.reDyn = none⌝

theorem HbAckOk_w64Max (v x y : w64) (recs : List RqRec) : HbAckOk v (uint.nat x) recs → HbAckOk v
    (uint.nat y) recs → HbAckOk v (uint.nat (w64Max x y)) recs

def MsgFree (ty : MsgType) : Bool :=
  match ty with
  | MsgType.preVote => true
  | MsgType.preVoteResp => true
  | x => false

theorem ownRaftGhost_isLeader [ReceiptGS GF] {md : Bool} [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) : s.role = Role.leader → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ isLeader γ id s.term

theorem lcmLead_nl [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (s : PState) (lcm : GMap w64 GName) (h : s.role ≠
    Role.leader) : lcmLead s lcm = iprop(True)

theorem matchedOk_eq [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s1 s2 : PState) : s2.role = s1.role
    → s2.term = s1.term → s2.matched = s1.matched → ⊢ matchedOk γ s1 -∗ matchedOk γ s2

theorem committedJust_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : Timeless
    (committedJust γ l)

theorem rdCred_split [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (a b : Nat) : rdCred γ (a + b) ⊣⊢
    rdCred γ a ∗ rdCred γ b

theorem rlq_add : rlq + rlq = Qp.half 1

theorem campOwn_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (F : List EntryM) : Persistent
    (campOwn γ id s F)

theorem raftLogN_sub {γ : RaftNames} : ↑(raftLogN γ) ⊆ ⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)

theorem ownRaftGhost_follower_votes [ReceiptGS GF] {md : Bool} [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ ⌜FollowerVotesOk s⌝

theorem isMessage_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : Persistent (isMessage γ m)

theorem propSlotRes_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (p : PropRec) (l : List EntryM) :
    Persistent (propSlotRes γ d p l)

def readSlot [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (r : GName × List EntryM) (l : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Qr,
      savedPredOwn r.fst DFrac.discard Qr ∗
        readAu γ Qr ∗ ⌜r.snd <+: l⌝ ∗ □ ∀ n, ⌜r.snd.length ≤ n ∧ n ≤ l.length⌝ -∗ □ Qr (List.take n l))

def logRest (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(entsData γ l ∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog rlq l)

def qRes (γq : GName) (L : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Q, savedPredOwn γq DFrac.discard Q ∗ □ Q L)

def raftLogInvBody [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l, ownCommitted γ l ∗ committedJust γ l ∗ votesTbl γ ∗ winTbl γ ∗ logRest γ l)

theorem committedJust_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : Persistent
    (committedJust γ l)

theorem ownRaftGhost_mode [ReceiptGS GF] {md : Bool} [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ ⌜γ.reDyn.isSome = md⌝

theorem isMessage_grant_inv [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.voteResp →
    m.reject = false → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ isVote γ m.src m.term m.dst

theorem uint_nat_le_of_Z_le {a b : w64} (h : uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z b) : uint.nat a ≤ uint.nat b

theorem readAu_fire [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (Qr : List EntryM → IProp GF) (l :
    List EntryM) : ⊢ readAu γ Qr -∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) l ={⊤ \ ↑(raftN γ)}=∗ ghostVar
    γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) l ∗ □ Qr l

theorem HbAckOk_app (v : w64) (q : Nat) (recs more : List RqRec) : HbAckOk v q recs → HbAckOk v q
    (recs ++ more)

theorem msgCert_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : Persistent (msgCert γ m)

theorem rdOwn_hbResp_pos [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (Hr :
    s.role = Role.leader) (recs0 : List RqRec) (q : w64) (Hq : uint.nat q ≤ recs0.length) : ⊢ rdOwn
    γ id s -∗ rqLb γ id s.term recs0 -∗ ⌜uint.nat q ≤ uint.nat s.rd.ro.confirmed +
    s.rd.ro.pending.length⌝

theorem raftCommitInv_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : Persistent
    (raftCommitInv γ)

theorem entsData_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : Persistent (entsData γ l)

def doomed [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T t' : w64) (U : GSet w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ n G a c q,
      ⌜uint.Z T < uint.Z t' ∧ 0 < uint.Z n ∧ ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ q → x ∈ U⌝ ∗
        cqAt γ t' n G a c q ∗
          (∀ u x, ∃ t'' i'', ⌜uint.Z T < uint.Z t'' ∧ 0 < uint.Z i''⌝ ∗ isAcked γ u t'' i'') ∗
            dynOn γ
              iprop(∀ k x x,
                  ∃ tw nw Gw aw cw qw,
                    ⌜WitOk G k tw nw Gw aw (uint.Z t' + 1) ∧ (uint.Z T < uint.Z tw → ∀ (x : w64), x ∈ qw → x ∈ U)⌝ ∗
                      cqAt γ tw nw Gw aw cw qw))

theorem msgCert_of_ne [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) (h : m.ty ≠ MsgType.snap) : ⊢ msgCert
    γ m

theorem doomed_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T t' : w64) (q : GSet w64) : Persistent
    (doomed γ T t' q)

def RoleOk (id : w64) (s : PState) : Prop :=
  (s.role ≠ Role.follower → s.vote = id) ∧ (s.role = Role.candidate → s.lead = W64 0)

theorem votesTbl_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : Timeless (votesTbl γ)

def isMessage [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : IProp GF :=
  match m.ty with
  | MsgType.vote =>
    iprop(∃ Fc,
        isCamp γ m.src m.term Fc ∗
          ⌜plogLast base0 Fc = { term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index }⌝ ∗ dynOn γ (campDyn γ m.src m.term Fc))
  | MsgType.voteResp => if m.reject = true then iprop(True) else isVote γ m.src m.term m.dst
  | MsgType.app =>
    iprop(⌜AppPayloadOk m⌝ ∗
        isLeader γ m.src m.term ∗
          (∃ bL l fp,
              leadPrefix γ m.src m.term bL l ∗
                ⌜plogTermAt bL l m.index = some m.logterm ∧ m.entries <+: plogFrom bL l (m.index + W64 1)⌝ ∗
                  lpfull γ m.src m.term bL l fp ∗
                    commitIn γ (fp ++ l) m.commit m.term ∗
                      isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z m.commit).toNat (fp ++ l)) ∗
                        dynOn γ iprop(⌜ConfI1 (fp ++ l) (uint.Z m.commit).toNat⌝)) ∗
            ⌜m.src ≠ W64 0⌝)
  | MsgType.appResp =>
    if m.reject = true then
      iprop(⌜γ.reBoot ≠ [] →
            ↑γ.reBoot.length < uint.Z m.index ∧ 1 ≤ uint.Z m.rejecthint ∧ uint.Z m.rejecthint ≤ uint.Z m.index⌝)
    else iprop(isAcked γ m.src m.term m.index ∗ ackIn γ m.term m.index)
  | MsgType.heartbeat =>
    iprop(isLeader γ m.src m.term ∗
        (∃ Fl,
            leadFull γ m.term Fl ∗ commitIn γ Fl m.commit m.term ∗ isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z m.commit).toNat Fl)) ∗
          (∃ i, ⌜uint.Z m.commit ≤ uint.Z i⌝ ∗ isAcked γ m.dst m.term i) ∗
            ⌜m.src ≠ W64 0⌝ ∗
              (⌜m.ctx = []⌝ ∨
                ∃ q recs,
                  ⌜m.ctx = u64Le q ∧ uint.nat q ≤ recs.length⌝ ∗
                    rqLb γ m.src m.term recs ∗ [∗list] r ∈ recs, rqRecOk γ m.term r))
  | MsgType.snap =>
    iprop(isLeader γ m.src m.term ∗
        isSnapMeta γ m.logterm m.index ∗
          (∃ bL l fp,
              leadPrefix γ m.src m.term bL l ∗
                ⌜plogTermAt bL l m.index = some m.logterm⌝ ∗
                  lpfull γ m.src m.term bL l fp ∗
                    commitIn γ (fp ++ l) m.index m.term ∗ isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z m.index).toNat (fp ++ l))) ∗
            ⌜m.src ≠ W64 0⌝ ∗ ⌜m.dst ≠ m.src ∧ ∀ (T : GSet w64), γ.reTracked = some T → m.src ∈ T ∧ m.dst ∈ T⌝)
  | MsgType.propose =>
    iprop(⌜m.term = W64 0 ∧ m.entries ≠ [] ∧ ↑m.entries.length < 2 ^ 61⌝ ∗ [∗list] e ∈ m.entries, propData γ e)
  | MsgType.heartbeatResp =>
    iprop(⌜m.ctx = []⌝ ∨ ∃ q recs, ⌜m.ctx = u64Le q ∧ HbAckOk m.src (uint.nat q) recs⌝ ∗ rqLb γ m.dst m.term recs)
  | MsgType.readIndex => iprop(∃ e c Lc, ⌜m.entries = [e]⌝ ∗ ⌜e.Data' = c⌝ ∗ readReq γ c Lc)
  | MsgType.readIndexResp => iprop(∃ e c, ⌜m.entries = [e]⌝ ∗ ⌜e.Data' = c⌝ ∗ readOk γ c m.index)
  | x => iprop(True)

theorem matchedOk_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) : Persistent (matchedOk γ s)

theorem lcmOwn_mono' [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) : (s'.role
    = Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term) → uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term →
    uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z s'.commit → (s'.role = Role.candidate → s.role = Role.candidate ∨
    uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term) → lcmOwn γ id s ⊢ lcmOwn γ id s'

theorem isMessageC_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : Persistent (isMessageC γ m)

def readsReg [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) (RR : GMap (List w8) (GName × List
    EntryM)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostMapAuth γ.reReads 1 RR ∗ [∗map] c ↦ r ∈ RR, iprop(readSlot γ r l ∗ rdFresh γ c))

theorem winTbl_timeless (γ : RaftNames) : Timeless (winTbl γ)

theorem readWit_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (Qr : List EntryM → IProp GF) (i : w64) :
    Persistent (readWit γ c Qr i)

theorem msgCert_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : Timeless (msgCert γ m)

def votesTbl [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : IProp GF :=
  [∗map] v ↦ γv ∈ γ.reVotes, iprop(∃ voted, ghostMapAuth γv (Qp.half 1) voted ∗ [∗map] T ↦ c ∈ voted, voteJust γ v T c)

def voteJust [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v T c : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ k d Fv Fc,
      isVlog γ v k T d Fv ∗
        isCamp γ c T Fc ∗
          logRecs γ base0 Fv ∗
            ⌜PlogWf base0 Fv ∧ plogUpToDate base0 Fv (plogLast base0 Fc) = true⌝ ∗
              (if d = true then ∃ ldr q, isWin γ ldr T q ∗ ⌜¬v ∈ q⌝ else True) ∗
                voteEv γ v T d Fv ∗ dynOn γ (campDyn γ c T Fc))

def propsOwn [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) (R : GMap (List w8)
    PropRec) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostMapAuth γ.reProps 1 R ∗ [∗map] d ↦ p ∈ R, iprop(propSlot γ d p l ∗ propFresh γ d))

def lcmLead (s : PState) (lcm : GMap w64 GName) : IProp GF :=
  match s.role with
  | Role.leader => iprop(∃ γc c, ⌜lcm !! s.term = some γc⌝ ∗ monoNatAuthOwn γc 1 c ∗ ⌜c ≤ uint.nat s.commit⌝)
  | x => iprop(True)

theorem raftLogN_of {γ : RaftNames} {E : CoPset} (HE : ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ E) : ↑(raftLogN γ) ⊆ E

def depSlot [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (γq γt : GName) (l : List
    EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ Q, savedPredOwn γq DFrac.discard Q ∗ propAu1 γ d Q) ∨
      ∃ i, dghostVar γt DFrac.discard (some i) ∗ ⌜uint.Z i ≤ ↑l.length⌝)

theorem raftRegInv_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : Persistent (raftRegInv γ)

def rqRecOk [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T : w64) (r : RqRec) : IProp GF :=
  match r.snd with
  | none => readOk γ r.fst.fst r.fst.snd
  | some p => doomed γ T p.fst p.snd

theorem lcmOwn_commit [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) (n : w64)
    : s.role = Role.leader → s'.role = Role.leader → s'.term = s.term → s'.commit = n → uint.Z
    s.commit ≤ uint.Z n → lcmOwn γ id s ⊢ |==> (lcmOwn γ id s' ∗ cmtLb γ id s.term n)

theorem isMessageC_intro [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ msgCert γ m
    -∗ isMessageC γ m

def winTbl (γ : RaftNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ W,
      ghostMapAuth γ.reTbl 1 W ∗ [∗map] T ↦ r ∈ W, iprop(isWinCore γ r.fst.fst T r.fst.snd r.snd ∗ T ↪[γ.reTbl]□ r))

def ownEvs (γ : RaftNames) (id T : w64) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γe evs,
      ⌜γ.reEvs !! id = some γe⌝ ∗
        monoListAuthOwn γe 1 evs ∗
          ⌜EvSorted evs ∧
              (∀ (e : Aev), e ∈ evs → uint.Z (aevTerm e) ≤ uint.Z T) ∧
                ∀ (t i : w64), Aev.ack t i ∈ evs → (acks !! (t, i)).isSome = true⌝)

theorem campDyn_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c T : w64) (F : List EntryM) : Persistent
    (campDyn γ c T F)

theorem ownEvs_mono [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id T T' : w64) (acks acks' : GMap (w64 × w64)
    Unit) : uint.Z T ≤ uint.Z T' → (∀ (k : w64 × w64), (acks !! k).isSome = true → (acks' !!
    k).isSome = true) → ⊢ ownEvs γ id T acks -∗ ownEvs γ id T' acks'

def isRead (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (Qr : List EntryM → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γq Lc, c ↪[γ.reReads]□ (γq, Lc) ∗ savedPredOwn γq DFrac.discard Qr)

theorem rdCount_singleton (m : Msg) : rdCount [m] = if m.ty = MsgType.readIndex then 1 else 0

def ackOk [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (k : w64 × w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ x, ackAgree γ s.base s.log k.fst k.snd)

theorem lcmOwn_win [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) : s.role =
    Role.candidate → s'.role = Role.leader → s'.term = s.term → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z s'.commit →
    lcmOwn γ id s ⊢ |==> lcmOwn γ id s'

def vlogsOk [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) (vlogs : GMap
    Nat ((w64 × Bool) × List EntryM)) : IProp GF :=
  [∗map] x ∈ vlogs,
    iprop(⌜uint.Z x.fst.fst ≤ uint.Z s.term⌝ ∗
        [∗map] k ↦ _u ∈ acks, iprop(∀ x_1, hist γ x.snd k.fst k.snd (vbnd x.fst.fst x.fst.snd)))

theorem raftLogN_of_diff {γ : RaftNames} {E : CoPset} (HE : ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ E) : ↑(raftLogN γ) ⊆ E \
    ↑(raftRegN γ)

def rdLead [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (rqm : GMap w64 GName) : IProp GF :=
  match s.role with
  | Role.leader =>
    iprop(∃ γq recs,
        ⌜rqm !! s.term = some γq⌝ ∗
          monoListAuthOwn γq 1 recs ∗
            ([∗list] r ∈ recs, rqRecOk γ s.term r) ∗
              ⌜recs.length = uint.nat s.rd.ro.confirmed + s.rd.ro.pending.length⌝ ∗
                ([∗list] k ↦ q ∈ s.rd.ro.pending,
                    iprop(∃ r e,
                        ⌜recs[uint.nat s.rd.ro.confirmed + k]? = some r ∧ q.index = r.fst.snd ∧ q.ents = [e]⌝ ∗
                          ⌜e.Data' = r.fst.fst⌝)) ∗
                  ⌜∀ (v a : w64), s.rd.ro.acks !! v = some a → HbAckOk v (uint.nat a) recs⌝ ∗ rdCred γ recs.length)
  | x => iprop(⌜s.rd.ro = { pending := [], acks := ∅, confirmed := W64 0 }⌝)

theorem votesTbl_insert [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (γv : GName) (voted : GMap w64
    w64) (T c : w64) : γ.reVotes !! id = some γv → voted !! T = none → ⊢ voteJust γ id T c -∗
    votesTbl γ -∗ ghostMapAuth γv (Qp.half 1) voted ==∗ votesTbl γ ∗ ghostMapAuth γv (Qp.half 1) <[T
    := c]>voted ∗ T ↪[γv]□ c

theorem readStateRaw_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (st : ReadStateM) : Persistent (readStateRaw γ st)

theorem rdLead_nl [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (rqm : GMap w64 GName) (h :
    s.role ≠ Role.leader) : rdLead γ s rqm = iprop(⌜s.rd.ro = { pending := [], acks := ∅, confirmed
    := W64 0 }⌝)

theorem ownRaftGhost_lead_ok [ReceiptGS GF] {md : Bool} [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ ⌜LeadOk id s⌝

theorem voteEv_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v T : w64) (d : Bool) (F : List EntryM) :
    Timeless (voteEv γ v T d F)

def rdCredN (γ : RaftNames) : Namespace :=
  raftN γ.@"read_credits"

def rdCount (ms : List Msg) : Nat :=
  List.countP (fun m => decide (m.ty = MsgType.readIndex)) ms

theorem ownEvs_ack [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id T : w64) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) (i :
    w64) : ⊢ ownEvs γ id T acks ==∗ ownEvs γ id T <[(T, i) := ()]>acks ∗ ackEv γ id T i

def propSlot [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (p : PropRec) (l : List EntryM)
    : IProp GF :=
  iprop(propSlotRes γ d p l ∗ ∃ K, ghostMapAuth p.snd 1 K ∗ [∗map] γt ∈ K, depSlot γ d p.fst γt l)

def RqRec : Type :=
  (List w8 × w64) × Option (w64 × GSet w64)

theorem rdOwn_drain [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (o' out : List
    Msg) (Hp : (o' ++ out).Perm s.outbox) : rdOwn γ id s ⊢ rdOwn γ id { term := s.term, vote :=
    s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := o', base := s.base, log :=
    s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd } ∗ rdCred γ (rdCount s.outbox -
    rdCount o') ∗ msgsTks γ out

theorem vlogsOk_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64)
    Unit) (vlogs : GMap Nat ((w64 × Bool) × List EntryM)) : Persistent (vlogsOk γ s acks vlogs)

theorem rdFresh_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) : Timeless (rdFresh γ c)

def matchedOk (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) : IProp GF :=
  match s.role with
  | Role.leader => [∗map] v ↦ i ∈ s.matched, isAcked γ v s.term i
  | x => iprop(True)

def entsData (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ods, [∗list] e;o ∈ l;ods, entDataIs γ e o)

def campOwn (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (F : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  match s.role with
  | Role.candidate => isCamp γ id s.term F
  | Role.leader =>
    iprop(∃ F0,
        isCamp γ id s.term F0 ∗
          ⌜F0 <+: F ∧ plogLastIndexZ base0 F0 < plogLastIndexZ base0 F ∧ (plogLast base0 F).term' = s.term⌝)
  | Role.follower => iprop(True)

theorem lcmOwn_bound_keep [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (n :
    w64) : s.role = Role.leader → ⊢ lcmOwn γ id s -∗ cmtLb γ id s.term n -∗ lcmOwn γ id s ∗ ⌜uint.Z
    n ≤ uint.Z s.commit⌝

theorem HbAckOk_le (v : w64) (q q' : Nat) (recs : List RqRec) : q' ≤ q → HbAckOk v q recs → HbAckOk
    v q' recs

theorem isMessageC_isMessage [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : isMessageC γ m ⊢ isMessage γ
    m

theorem hbCtx_isMessage [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id T : w64) (r : ReadOnly) (ctx :
    List w8) (recs : List RqRec) : HbCtxOk r ctx → recs.length = uint.nat r.confirmed +
    r.pending.length → ⊢ rqLb γ id T recs -∗ ([∗list] x ∈ recs, rqRecOk γ T x) -∗ ⌜ctx = []⌝ ∨ ∃ q
    recs, ⌜ctx = u64Le q ∧ uint.nat q ≤ recs.length⌝ ∗ rqLb γ id T recs ∗ [∗list] x ∈ recs, rqRecOk
    γ T x

def rdCredInv [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv (rdCredN γ) iprop(∃ B, own γ.reRdCred (● B) ∗ ⌜B < 2 ^ 64 - 1⌝)

theorem qRes_persistent (γq : GName) (L : List EntryM) : Persistent (qRes γq L)

theorem rdOwn_mono' [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) : (s'.role
    = Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term ∧ s'.rd = s.rd) → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader
    → s'.rd.ro = { pending := [], acks := ∅, confirmed := W64 0 } ∨ s.role ≠ Role.leader ∧ s'.rd.ro
    = s.rd.ro) → uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term → s'.rd.states = s.rd.states → s'.rd.pend =
    s.rd.pend → rdCount s'.outbox ≤ rdCount s.outbox → (propsOf s'.outbox).Subperm (propsOf
    s.outbox) → (s'.role = Role.candidate → s.role = Role.candidate ∨ uint.Z s.term < uint.Z
    s'.term) → rdOwn γ id s ⊢ rdOwn γ id s'

theorem rdOwn_update [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) (sts :
    List ReadStateM) (ps : List (MessageM × List EntryM)) (ms : List Msg) : s'.role = s.role →
    s'.term = s.term → s'.rd.ro = s.rd.ro → s'.rd.states = s.rd.states ++ sts → s'.rd.pend =
    s.rd.pend ++ ps → s'.outbox = s.outbox ++ ms → (∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → m.ty ≠ MsgType.propose) →
    ⊢ rdOwn γ id s -∗ ([∗list] st ∈ sts, readStateRaw γ st) -∗ ([∗list] p ∈ ps, iprop(∃ e c Lc,
    ⌜p.snd = [e]⌝ ∗ ⌜e.Data' = c⌝ ∗ readReq γ c Lc)) -∗ rdCred γ (ps.length + rdCount ms) -∗ rdOwn γ
    id s'

theorem isMessage_reject [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (src dst term : w64) : ⊢ isMessage γ
    (Msg.plain MsgType.voteResp src dst term true)

def raftRegN (γ : RaftNames) : Namespace :=
  raftN γ.@"reg"

theorem ownRaftGhost_intro [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (γv :
    GName) (voted : GMap w64 w64) (kl : Option w64) {md : Bool} : γ.reVotes !! id = some γv → id ≠
    W64 0 → γ.reDyn.isSome = md → ⊢ ghostMapAuth γv (Qp.half 1) voted -∗ ⌜VoteHistOk voted s⌝ -∗
    ([∗map] t ↦ c ∈ voted, isVote γ id t c) -∗ ([∗list] m ∈ s.outbox, isMessage γ m) -∗ ([∗map] v ↦
    _u ∈ toMap (granted s.votes), isVote γ v s.term id) -∗ leaderWit γ id s -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl
    -∗ ⌜LeadOk id s⌝ -∗ ⌜FollowerVotesOk s⌝ -∗ ([∗map] t ↦ c ∈ voted, voteJust γ id t c) -∗ ⌜RoleOk
    id s⌝ -∗ lcmOwn γ id s -∗ rdOwn γ id s -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md

theorem elem_of_granted_recordVote (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (src : w64) (b : Bool) (v : w64) : v ∈
    granted (recordVote votes src b) → v ∈ granted votes ∨ v = src ∧ b = true

theorem readSlot_persistent [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (r : GName × List EntryM) (l : List EntryM) :
    Persistent (readSlot γ r l)

theorem uint_nat_eq (w : w64) : ↑(uint.nat w) = uint.Z w

def regsOwn [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l, ghostVar γ.reRLog rlq l ∗ regsAt γ l)

def LcmOk (lcm : GMap w64 GName) (s : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : w64), (lcm !! t).isSome = true → uint.Z t < uint.Z s.term ∨ t = s.term ∧ s.role ≠ Role.candidate

def TermsLe (s : PState) (F : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j x : w64),
    plogTermAt base0 F j = some x → uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z s.term ∧ (s.role = Role.candidate → uint.Z x < uint.Z s.term)

theorem rdCredN_sub {γ : RaftNames} : ↑(rdCredN γ) ⊆ ⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)

theorem propIs_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (Q : List EntryM → IProp GF) : Persistent
    (propIs γ d Q)

def rlq : Qp :=
  (Qp.half 1).half

theorem isMessageC_snap_cert [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) (h : m.ty = MsgType.snap) :
    isMessageC γ m ⊢ raftSnapCert γ (msgSnapTrip m)

def rqLb (γ : RaftNames) (L T : w64) (recs : List RqRec) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γl γq, ⌜γ.reRdq !! L = some γl⌝ ∗ T ↪[γl]□ γq ∗ monoListLbOwn γq recs)

def dynEnv [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (c : CfgM) (s : PState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜CfgStatic γ c⌝ ∨
      ⌜γ.reDyn ≠ none⌝ ∗
        ∃ fpR a,
          ⌜FullOk s.base fpR ∧
                ConfI1 (fpR ++ s.log) (uint.Z s.commit).toNat ∧
                  uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z s.commit ∧
                    CfgAt γ (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat (fpR ++ s.log)) c ∧
                      (s.role = Role.leader → confCount (List.drop (uint.Z a).toNat (fpR ++ s.log)) ≤ 1) ∧
                        (s.role = Role.candidate → a = s.commit)⌝ ∗
            logRecs γ base0 fpR ∗ ∀ x, isCampK γ id s.term (fpR ++ s.log) s.commit)

theorem voteEv_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v T : w64) (d : Bool) (F : List EntryM) :
    Persistent (voteEv γ v T d F)

def voteEv [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v T : w64) (d : Bool) (F : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γe L0, ⌜γ.reEvs !! v = some γe⌝ ∗ monoListLbOwn γe (L0 ++ [Aev.vote T d F]) ∗ ∀ t i x, hist γ F t i (vbnd T d))

theorem rdOwn_send [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (ms : List Msg)
    (h : rdCount ms = 0) : ⊢ rdOwn γ id s -∗ msgsTks γ ms -∗ rdOwn γ id (psendMsgs s ms)

theorem raftCommitInv_log [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : raftCommitInv γ ⊢ raftLogInv γ

theorem isVlog_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (v : w64) (k : Nat) (T : w64) (d : Bool) (F : List EntryM) :
    Timeless (isVlog γ v k T d F)

theorem campDyn_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c T : w64) (F : List EntryM) : Timeless
    (campDyn γ c T F)

def rdFresh (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) : IProp GF :=
  c ↪[γ.reRdFresh] ()

def acksOk [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) : IProp GF :=
  match s.role with
  | Role.leader => iprop(True)
  | x => [∗map] k ↦ _u ∈ acks, ackOk γ s k

theorem rdOwn_takePend [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) : rdOwn γ
    id s ⊢ rdOwn γ id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes :=
    s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched :=
    s.matched, rd :=
            have __src := s.rd;
            { states := __src.states, ro := __src.ro } } ∗
      ([∗list] p ∈ s.rd.pend, iprop(∃ e c Lc, ⌜p.snd = [e]⌝ ∗ ⌜e.Data' = c⌝ ∗ readReq γ c Lc)) ∗
        rdCred γ s.rd.pend.length

theorem readOk_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (i : w64) : Persistent (readOk γ c i)

theorem propFresh_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) : Timeless (propFresh γ d)

theorem readReq_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (Lc : List EntryM) : Persistent (readReq γ
    c Lc)

def readWit (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (Qr : List EntryM → IProp GF) (i : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(isRead γ c Qr ∗ readOk γ c i)

theorem VoteHistOk_eq (voted : GMap w64 w64) (s1 s2 : PState) : VoteHistOk voted s1 → s2.term =
    s1.term → s2.vote = s1.vote → VoteHistOk voted s2

theorem rdOwn_takeReads [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) : rdOwn γ
    id s ⊢ rdOwn γ id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes :=
    s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched :=
    s.matched, rd :=
            have __src := s.rd;
            { ro := __src.ro, pend := __src.pend } } ∗
      [∗list] st ∈ s.rd.states, readStateRaw γ st

theorem rdCred_bound [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (n : Nat) (E : CoPset) (HE :
    ↑(rdCredN γ) ⊆ E) : ⊢ rdCredInv γ -∗ rdCred γ n ={E}=∗ rdCred γ n ∗ ⌜n < 2 ^ 64 - 1⌝

def raftN (γ : RaftNames) : Namespace :=
  γ.reNs

theorem granted_empty : granted ∅ = ∅

theorem rdCred_zero_upd [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : ⊢ |==> rdCred γ 0

theorem respFacts_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (q : ReadReq) : Persistent (respFacts γ q)

theorem elem_of_granted (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (v : w64) : v ∈ granted votes ↔ votes !! v = some
    true

theorem voteJust_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v T c : w64) : Persistent (voteJust γ v
    T c)

def lcmOwn (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γl lcm,
      ⌜γ.reLcm !! id = some γl⌝ ∗
        ghostMapAuth γl 1 lcm ∗ ([∗map] t ↦ γc ∈ lcm, t ↪[γl]□ γc) ∗ ⌜LcmOk lcm s⌝ ∗ lcmLead s lcm)

theorem rdOwn_win [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) : s.role =
    Role.candidate → s'.role = Role.leader → s'.term = s.term → s'.rd = rdNL s.rd → rdCount
    s'.outbox ≤ rdCount s.outbox → (propsOf s'.outbox).Subperm (propsOf s.outbox) → rdOwn γ id s ⊢
    |==> rdOwn γ id s'

theorem propAu1_fire [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (Q : List EntryM →
    IProp GF) (l : List EntryM) (e : EntryM) (Hidx : uint.Z e.Index' = ↑l.length + 1) (Hrb : uint.Z
    e.Index' < ↑(receiptBound GF) + ↑γ.reBoot.length) : ⊢ propAu1 γ d Q -∗ entDataIs γ e (some d) -∗
    ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) l ={⊤ \ ↑(raftN γ)}=∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) (l ++ [e]) ∗ □
    Q l

def isVlog (γ : RaftNames) (v : w64) (k : Nat) (T : w64) (d : Bool) (F : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γl, ⌜γ.reVlogs !! v = some γl⌝ ∗ k ↪[γl]□ ((T, d), F))

def TermsOk (terms : GMap w64 TermRec) (s : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : w64), (terms !! t).isSome = true → uint.Z t < uint.Z s.term ∨ t = s.term ∧ s.role ≠ Role.candidate

theorem raftRegN_of {γ : RaftNames} {E : CoPset} (HE : ↑(raftN γ) ⊆ E) : ↑(raftRegN γ) ⊆ E

theorem raftLogInv_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : Persistent (raftLogInv γ)

theorem rqRecOk_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T : w64) (r : RqRec) : Persistent
    (rqRecOk γ T r)

theorem ownRaftGhost_outbox [ReceiptGS GF] {md : Bool} [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ [∗list] m ∈ s.outbox, isMessage γ m

def rLog (γ : RaftNames) (L : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) L

theorem noopAu_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : Persistent (noopAu γ)

def klOk (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl : Option w64) : IProp GF :=
  match kl with
  | none => iprop(⌜s.role ≠ Role.leader⌝)
  | some ldr => iprop((∃ q, isWin γ ldr s.term q ∗ ⌜s.vote = W64 0 → ¬id ∈ q⌝) ∗ ⌜s.role = Role.leader → ldr = id⌝)

theorem propSlot_res [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (p : PropRec) (l : List
    EntryM) : propSlot γ d p l ⊢ propSlot γ d p l ∗ propSlotRes γ d p l

def WinsOk (wins : GMap w64 (GSet w64)) (s : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : w64), (wins !! t).isSome = true → uint.Z t < uint.Z s.term ∨ t = s.term ∧ s.role ≠ Role.candidate

def bnd (s : PState) (kl : Option w64) : Int :=
  match kl with
  | some val => uint.Z s.term + 1
  | none => uint.Z s.term

def campDyn [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c T : w64) (F : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ k tm,
      ⌜uint.Z tm < uint.Z T ∧ ConfI1 F (uint.Z k).toNat ∧ PlogWf base0 F⌝ ∗
        isCampK γ c T F k ∗ logRecs γ base0 F ∗ commitIn γ F k tm)

def VoteHistOk (voted : GMap w64 w64) (s : PState) : Prop :=
  (∀ (t : w64), (voted !! t).isSome = true → uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z s.term) ∧
    voted !! s.term = if s.vote = W64 0 then none else some s.vote

def readReq (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (Lc : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γq, c ↪[γ.reReads]□ (γq, Lc) ∗ isCommitted γ Lc)

theorem lcmOwn_mono [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) : (s'.role
    = Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term) → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader → s.role =
    Role.leader → uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term) → uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term → uint.Z s.commit
    ≤ uint.Z s'.commit → (s'.role = Role.candidate → s.role = Role.candidate ∨ uint.Z s.term <
    uint.Z s'.term) → lcmOwn γ id s ⊢ lcmOwn γ id s'

theorem acksOk_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit)
    : Persistent (acksOk γ s acks)

theorem isMessage_appResp_ackIn [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.appResp →
    m.reject = false → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ ackIn γ m.term m.index

def propSlotRes (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (p : PropRec) (l : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ ∀ m e, ⌜l[m]? = some e⌝ -∗ entDataIs γ e (some d) -∗ qRes p.fst (List.take m l))

def raftRegInv [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv (raftRegN γ) (regsOwn γ)

theorem isRead_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (c : List w8) (Qr : List EntryM → IProp GF) : Persistent
    (isRead γ c Qr)

theorem isMessage_free [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : MsgFree m.ty = true → ⊢ isMessage
    γ m

def isMessageC [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(isMessage γ m ∗ msgCert γ m)

theorem leaderWit_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) : Persistent (leaderWit γ id s)

theorem histsOk_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (kl : Option w64) (F : List
    EntryM) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) : Persistent (histsOk γ s kl F acks)

def AcksTerm (s : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : w64 × w64), (acks !! k).isSome = true → uint.Z k.fst ≤ uint.Z s.term

theorem isVlog_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (v : w64) (k : Nat) (T : w64) (d : Bool) (F : List EntryM)
    : Persistent (isVlog γ v k T d F)

def noopAu [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      AU <{ ∃∃ L, rLog γ L }> @ ⊤ \ ↑(raftN γ), ∅ <{ ∀∀ e,
          rLog γ (L ++ [e]) ∗
            entDataIs γ e none ∗
              ⌜uint.Z e.Index' = ↑L.length + 1 ∧ uint.Z e.Index' < ↑(receiptBound GF) + ↑γ.reBoot.length⌝,
          COMM True }>)

def LeadAcksOk (s : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) : Prop :=
  (s.role = Role.candidate → ∀ (i : w64), acks !! (s.term, i) = none) ∧
    (s.role = Role.leader → ∀ (i : w64), (acks !! (s.term, i)).isSome = true → uint.Z i ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log)

def propIs (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (Q : List EntryM → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p, d ↪[γ.reProps]□ p ∗ savedPredOwn p.fst DFrac.discard Q)

theorem voteJust_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v T c : w64) : Timeless (voteJust γ v T c)
